top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings  - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4807(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The swings use zone is overlapping with a rotating structure's use zone.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A large unmounted fan was accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the director turned off the fan and removed it from the area.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection- Inspection unavailable must maintain documentation at operation and make available to us (26 TAC §746.3401(c)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the Monitoring Inspection, the operation could not provide documentation of a current Health/Sanitation Inspection conducted as required.
